messages:
Nisha: Quick sync: compact compare review — a few small UX / accessibility nits I noticed in the model catalog compare flow.
Oliver: Thanks — dropping a quick list. Can we aim to ship the copy tweaks + contrast fixes this week? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Sam: Pinged infra about table perf — nothing blocking the UI changes.
Liam: Main a11y items: focus order on row pin actions, keyboard-only discoverability for compare controls, and badge color contrast.
Maya: TL;DR of suggested copy: 'Pin to compare' -> 'Pin version' or 'Pin this version'? I prefer short.
Oliver: I prefer 'Pin version' — consistent with 'Unpin' CTA. 'Pin to compare' feels verbose.
Nisha: Agree with 'Pin version' but earlier product docs used 'Pin to compare' — we should update docs if we change.
Sam: Technical note: pin is implemented as a toggle button; we can add aria-pressed and aria-label easily.
Liam: Example aria: 
```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin version 2.1 of Falcon-1 for comparison">📌</button>
```
Oliver: Also flag: performance badges (throughput / latency) use green/orange/red. Contrast issue on the orange badge at small sizes — hex #F6A623 fails AA.
Nisha: Can we switch orange to #E07A1A or add a subtle outline when badge text < 12px?
Maya: Also requested: make the compare table density toggle persist per-user (local storage + backend opt-in later).
Sam: Persisting in local storage is trivial; we'll add backend flag later for cross-device.
Oliver: Tiny microcopy nits: 'Version pinned' vs 'Pinned' — where do we show it? On the model row or the compare header?
Nisha: Show 'Pinned' pill on the row and keep a 'Pinned versions' counter in header. That helps discovery.
Liam: Keyboard: hitting Enter on a focused pin must toggle. Also add visible focus ring: 2px solid #2563EB with 3px offset.
DesignBot: Uploaded new frames: https://figma.com/file/xyz - updated pins + badge contrasts
Oliver: I'll push a patch to the components lib: aria-labels, focus styles, and badge color tokens.
Maya: Can someone update the product copy doc with final wording? I'll review after.
Nisha: Thanks all — let's aim for a small rollout behind a feature flag. If no objections I'll add to next sprint.
Oliver: :+1: 
Sam: :shipit: 
Liam: :white_check_mark: 
Maya: Thanks!
